title: Noah's Vanilla Plus
description: A vanilla plus overhaul in my eyes!
body:
This Modpack is purely a Vanilla plus overhaul in my eyes. For those who want Basicly Vanilla minecraft but with a newer and less repetitive feel

   ive added structures changed about or if not all Vanilla structures and added terralith for enchanced terrain, ive added freshanimations and all avalible add ons for this version, ive added a texture pack, and other particle visuals and distant horizons to enchance the looks! and dont worry i optimized the modpack as much as possible. i added Qol mods like mouse tweaks, auto hud(you can configure as you please) hardcore revival wich allows you to be revived by friends in hardcore(also works for normal survival), a disenchanting table!. i also added Essential for playing with friends!

It's not perfect i know but more will be added when more is avalible for 1.21.10

[Fresh animations!](https://modrinth.com/project/50dA9Sha), my yt:[It's Noah!](https://www.youtube.com/@itsnoah0520)
